column1: # The DNS records of jeffreypalermo.com as its name servers (ns1, ns2, ns3.wordpress.com) answered on 2026-10-08 at

# Columns: name (in the zone; @ is the zone's own name, * every other name), type, ttl, value, zone, note.
# zone says what the Azure DNS zone of deploy/infra/dns-zone.bicep does with the record (ADR-0016):
#   kept     the zone holds it exactly: mail and what proves mail
#   site     one of the site's three names: the zone holds it as it is here until the name is a host name of the
#            site, and then gives the name to the Front Door
#   own      the DNS host's own record of the zone; the new host writes its own
#   dropped  not carried over, for the reason in the note
